info.name: Companies House Public Data charges personsWithSignificantControl API
List the company persons with significant control

params.name: company_number
params.description: The company number of the persons with significant control list being requested.

params.name: items_per_page
params.description: The number of persons with significant control to return per page.

params.name: start_index
params.description: The offset into the entire result set that this page starts.

params.name: register_view
params.description:
Display register specific information. If register is held at Companies House and register_view is set to true, only PSCs which are active or were terminated during election period are shown. Accepted values are: -`true`  
 -`false`  
 Defaults to false.

items.docs: List of all persons with significant control (not statements)
